title: Pay the bill
subtitle: Bill {number}
loadFailed: Could not load the payment details. Try again.
includesEarlier: Includes what is unpaid on earlier bills (this bill: {balance}); payments go to the oldest bill first.
expiredBody: Get a new one — the amount stays the same.
saveHintLine: In LINE you can also press and hold the QR to save it.
saveFailed: Could not save the picture — take a screenshot instead.
openBankHint: Pick your bank, then scan the saved QR from your photos. If nothing opens, open the banking app yourself.

steps.save: Save the QR picture or take a screenshot.
steps.scan: Open your banking app, choose scan, and pick the QR from your photos.
steps.back: Come back here — we confirm the payment by ourselves.

waiting: Waiting for your payment — this screen updates by itself when the money arrives.
noQrTransfer: Transfer to {bank}, account {account} ({name}), then send us the slip.
noQrContact: Ask the building office how to pay this bill.
slipCta: Paid by transfer? Send the slip

push.title: Hear about your next bill?
push.body: Turn on notifications in this browser to know when a new bill is ready or a payment arrived.
push.denied: The browser blocked notifications. You can change that in its settings.
push.failed: Could not turn on notifications. Try again later.

slip.lead: Transfer {amount} to the landlord's account, then send the transfer slip.
slip.shootHint: Keep the slip inside the frame, numbers readable.

too_large.title: The file is too large
too_large.body: Choose a slip picture or PDF under 3.5 MB.

unsupported.title: This file cannot be opened
unsupported.body: Send the slip as a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF.

slip.checkBody: Check that it is the slip of this transfer, for {amount}, and that it is readable.

outcome.pending: Checking the slip — it takes a moment; this screen updates by itself.
outcome.pendingNoStatus: We have your slip. Once it is confirmed the bill turns paid and the receipt comes in LINE.
outcome.confirmedBody: The slip passed the check; the receipt follows.
outcome.reviewBody: It could not be confirmed automatically. The building office will check it and tell you in LINE.

reasons.not_recognised: The slip could not be read, or it is not a transfer slip.
reasons.duplicate_reference: This transfer reference was used before.
reasons.receiver_mismatch: The receiving account on the slip is not the landlord's.
reasons.amount_above_due: The amount on the slip is more than what is due.
reasons.amount_below_due: The amount on the slip is less than what is due.
reasons.amount_unreadable: The amount on the slip could not be read.

outcome.duplicateBody: One transfer can pay only once. If you made a new transfer, send that slip.
outcome.rejectedBody: The office did not accept this slip. Contact the building office or pay with the QR.
